resolved_scenario.purpose: Easier controlled setting where true successors are more often temporally reachable and observed identity/text fields are less corrupted.

scoped_candidate_environment.note: v0.3 temporal/candidate revision block. These are bounded scenario parameters that originally lived only in v0.3 metadata; they now live in the scenario file so the released benchmark can be replayed from configuration. The scoped buyer-affinity/share values were re-swept after repairing buyer-activity allocation and primary-department sampling, and again after making the buyer activity Pareto shape explicit in this scenario: the older 0.07/0.70 and 0.07/0.50 settings became too dense once the observed high-activity tail was restored. The current 0.02/0.25 setting with near-window share 0.80 preserves the digital source scale and zero-candidate rate in the central world, while keeping production blocking completeness above its warning floor across the documented 10 central seeds and leaving the buyer-activity tail to be checked separately by the validation framework. Candidate counts remain post-hoc fidelity targets: this block controls plausible scoped recurrence timing and same-buyer distinct-need clustering, while preserving overall digital source scale. It never sets per-source candidate counts, linkage scores, accepted links, or thresholds.

conditional_siret_presence.note: Overrides the older year-regime scale for central_provisional in the v0.2 conditional revision. The target is checksum-clean SIRET presence; the absent mass is still split into SIREN-only, invalid, and missing official-identifier outcomes so the corruption vocabulary remains compatible with the current linkage pipeline.

conditional_presence.note: Overrides missing_rate_by_schema for central_provisional in the v0.2 conditional revision. Presence is estimated by observable schema/year/type rates. When present, the visible declared duration is sampled from valid raw BOAMP duration values instead of being rounded from hidden cycle length; latent true contract-cycle timing remains generated by the clean-world mechanism and is not inferred from BOAMP.

conditional_reuse.note: Replaces the high global boilerplate_rate in central_provisional v0.2. It separates exact cross-buyer template reuse from near-boilerplate text with row-specific tokens and generic weak procurement wording. This reduces unrealistic cross-buyer exact duplicates while preserving repeated administrative language. Same-family CALL/AWARD wording remains exact unless lexical drift is separately drawn; converting almost every award into a row-specific "near duplicate" erased the real corpus's high normalized duplicate share after corruption.

conditional_observation.note: Added after notebooks/07_synthetic_conditional_fidelity_validation.ipynb. Builds smoothed observable-rate tables for SIRET presence, duration presence, and exact cross-buyer repeated text. This changes only observed/corrupted fields; latent truth and CPV missingness remain governed by their existing mechanisms.

resolved_scenario.scenario_design_note: Varies only unidentified or stress-test parameters: recurrence timing, identifier persistence, name corruption, missingness severity, text drift, and hard-negative density. Linkage thresholds and score weights are held fixed algorithm parameters and do not define truth.
